stories.title: When PSUs, fertiliser shops, and flour mills became Uttarakhand’s ‘investors’ after global summit
stories.summary: Inaugurating the Uttarakhand Global Investors Summit on December 8, 2023, Prime Minister Narendra Modi declared the state a “new hub for investment”, crediting the “double engine” government’s push on tourism, connectivity and investment. There were grand numbers that followed: 1,779 MoUs worth Rs 3.56 lakh crore. Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami had chased them with roadshows in London and Dubai, and in Bengaluru, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Chennai and Mumbai – a courtship that cost taxpayers roughly Rs 100 crore, according to an RTI…
stories.why_it_matters: The issue affects investment, livelihoods or access to economic opportunity. Its significance depends on whether stated commitments translate into verifiable spending, fair access, lasting employment and accountable delivery.
stories.evidence_status: The account is based on reporting by Newslaundry. Official claims, allegations and projections remain attributed, and no additional independent corroboration is available in the reporting reviewed.

confidence.rationale: The report identifies the event, institution and timing, but the central account is supported by one source desk and underlying records were not independently reviewed.

coverage.rationale: The event appears in one public-interest or regional report despite broader relevance.
